meta.source: ONS, Educational attainment of young people in English towns (2023), OGL v3.0

variables.label: Town size
variables.description: Small, medium or large town (2011 population).

variables.label: Education score
variables.description: ONS composite of young people's attainment, standardised.

variables.label: Deprivation
variables.description: Income deprivation band: lower, mid or higher.

variables.label: Adult degrees
variables.description: Share of residents aged 35-64 with a degree-level qualification: low, medium or high.

variables.label: Region
variables.description: English region. Categorical, so it can be adjusted for but not used as a treatment or outcome.

variables.label: Coastal
variables.description: Whether the town is on the coast.

variables.label: University
variables.description: Whether the town has a university.
